PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Award-winning product designer and innovator specializing in robotics, 
medical devices, and advanced manufacturing. B.S. in Integrated Product 
Design (GPA 3.9, Dean's List). Proven track record designing and prototyping 
complex systems from concept through validation. Deep expertise in CAD, topology 
optimization, design-for-manufacturing, and autonomous systems.

SELECTED PROJECTS & CASE STUDIES

M.A.R.T.I.A.N Bot: Autonomous Mars Construction Robot
• 8-legged autonomous robot designed to excavate and build underground habitats 
  on Mars using locally sourced regolith
• Topology-optimized structural components for maximum strength-to-weight ratio
• 5-step autonomous DIG workflow (Terrain Assessment → Excavation → Framework → 
  Habitat Deployment → Burial & Shielding)
• Full ROS 2 + Gazebo simulation validation with accurate physics and sensor 
  noise modeling
• Recognized at JWU Symposium for Technology & Innovation (2024)

EcoPrint: 5-Axis 3D Printing Waste Reduction
• Investigated multi-axis toolpath strategies to reduce support-material waste 
  in additive manufacturing
• Compared 3-axis vs. 5-axis printing across geometry complexity, material usage, 
  and cost metrics
• Validated that 5-axis approaches reduce waste by 40–60% on complex geometries

BloominBeds Monitoring System
• Designed and built a Raspberry Pi sensor network for raised garden bed 
  temperature and humidity monitoring
• Implemented DHT22 sensors with real-time web dashboard
• Kept garden beds within safe growing conditions year-round
• Recognized at JWU Symposium for Creativity & Design (2024)

Total Ergonomics™ Micropipette
• User-centered ergonomic add-on designed for a lab technician with rheumatoid 
  arthritis
• Conducted comparative user testing across three prototypes
• Selected foot-pedal design maximized comfort and reduced repetitive strain
• Demonstrates deep commitment to accessible, human-centered design

EDISON AI Assistant
• Designed and built a fully offline, multi-modal AI platform with multi-GPU 
  LLM inference
• Integrated RAG memory, voice processing, and image generation on local hardware
• Exposed OpenAI-compatible API for seamless third-party integration
• Advanced prototyping of emerging AI/ML applications

Additional Case Studies: Artificial Magnetic Fields (Mars radiation shielding 
simulation), Willie's Café Space Study (data-driven seating analysis with ADA 
compliance), Growth Algorithm Simulation (parametric organic structure generation), 
Storage Concepts (modular + wearable personal storage), JRM Enterprises Feasibility 
Study ($2M business plan)
